concerns.text: Tasks T106-T113 (Rule Space Search, Kolmogorov complexity, exhaustiveness verification) have no corresponding FR/SC in spec.md. The spec authorizes FR-001 to FR-008 and SC-001 to SC-005, none of which mandate enumerating microcircuit rules or measuring algorithmic complexity. This creates a scope gap where the implementer cannot satisfy these tasks via the current spec.

Tasks T090-T092 (Metabolic Cost Analysis, 'bartender' narrative) address a reviewer concern (Geoffrey West) not present in the current spec.md. While FR-005 mentions 'cost of biological plausibility', it defines the metric as MAE vs. constraint degree, not 'intelligence (1/MAE) per wall-clock time'. There is no FR/SC authorizing the specific 'metabolic cost' definition or the 'bartender' report format.

Tasks T100-T105 (Rule Space Search, Logic Gate Benchmark, Irreducibility Detector) address a reviewer concern (Stephen Wolfram) not present in spec.md. The spec requires FR-003 (ablation) and FR-008 (scaling), but does not mandate enumerating a 'rule space', measuring 'computational irreducibility', or finding the 'simplest universal rule'. These tasks lack a spec anchor.

Task T106 references 'Rule 110' and 'exhaustiveness' of the search space. While the task exists, the spec.md contains no requirement to prove exhaustiveness or compare against Rule 110. This is a stale tag from an external review not yet incorporated into the spec.

Task T091 references a 'bartender explanation' metric. This specific narrative requirement is not found in spec.md or plan.md, indicating a task derived from an external conversation not yet formalized in the spec.
